# Trustpilot.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/trustpilot-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/trustpilot-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product listing data from Trustpilot.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Trustpilot.com Reviews and Company Data](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-trustpilot-com-reviews)
- **Code:** [`trustpilot.py`](trustpilot.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Company pages](results/companies.json) · [Reviews pages](results/reviews.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Trustpilot company pages for company data
- Trustpilot search pages for company listing data
- Trustpilot review pages for company reviews

## Functions

- `scrape_company(urls)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape trustpilot company pages
- `scrape_search(url, max_pages=None)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape trustpilot search pages
- `scrape_reviews(url, max_pages=None)` → `List[Dict]`: parse review data from the API

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import trustpilot


async def main():
    search = await trustpilot.scrape_search(
        url="https://www.trustpilot.com/categories/electronics_technology",
        max_pages=3,
    )
    company = await trustpilot.scrape_company(
        urls=[
            "https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.flashbay.com",
            "https://www.trustpilot.com/review/iggm.com",
        ],
    )
    reviews = await trustpilot.scrape_reviews(
        url="https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.bhphotovideo.com",
        max_pages=3,
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/companies.json`](results/companies.json): `pageUrl`, `companyDetails`, `reviews`
- [`results/reviews.json`](results/reviews.json): `id`, `filtered`, `pending`, `text`, `rating`, `labels`, `title`, `likes`, `dates`, `report`, `hasUnhandledReports`, `consumer`, `reply`, `consumersReviewCountOnSameDomain`, `consumersReviewCountOnSameLocation`, `productReviews`, `language`, `location`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `businessUnitId`, `stars`, `identifyingName`, `displayName`, `logoUrl`, `numberOfReviews`, `trustScore`, `location`, `isRecommendedInCategories`, `contact`, `categories`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`trustpilot.py`](trustpilot.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/trustpilot-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_company_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`, `test_review_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
